propositions: Per-client bearer PATs (copilot, codex, claude) must be materialized on-box from SSM at deploy time into .env as MCP_CLIENT_PAT_* environment variables, never committed or rsync'd
The static verifier's accepted-token JSON file (mcp-static-tokens.json) must reference materialized PATs via token_env variable names, never plaintext token values or raw PAT literals

mcp-clients.local.json (real credentials) and mcp-static-tokens.json must be gitignored and rsync-excluded, while a committed template mcp-clients.local.example.json documents the expected schema without secrets

Credential rotation requires operator-driven re-materialization from SSM plus StaticBearerVerifier process restart/replacement (blue-green swap); file-only rewrites have no effect on running verifiers
Guard test must assert git check-ignore matches gitignored credential paths and that no real PAT patterns exist in the committed tree
Blank credential slots (unset MCP_CLIENT_PAT_*) must omit the token_env record from the tokens file; all-blank slots produce {"tokens": []} and cause verifier startup failure (fail-closed)
